calibration.definition: The accuracy of your self-assessment: how closely your confidence matches your actual performance.

comfort_paradox.definition: The pattern in which removing difficulty lowers the tolerance for difficulty, making life feel harder even as it gets easier.

dice.definition: To cut something into small cubes.
dice.example: Please dice the mango for the salad.

gre_double_bind.definition: A situation in which a person is given two rules that cannot both be satisfied.
gre_double_bind.example: A double bind: be the one who decides, and be the one who notices that everybody is exhausted.

mole.definition: The SI unit of amount of substance.
mole.example: 18 g of water is about one mole.

optic_nerve.definition: The nerve that carries the picture from your eye to your brain.
optic_nerve.example: The optic nerve carries the picture along to the brain.

social_insurance.definition: The compulsory payment into the social insurance system that covers sickness, maternity, accidents and retirement.
social_insurance.example: My social insurance contribution is a percentage of my gross pay.
